subject: Essential Mathematics
title: Area of Polygons

outcomes.text: compute area of a triangle given two sides and an included acute angle,
determine the area of a triangle given three sides using Heron’s Formula,
determine the area of a rhombus and parallelogram in different situations,
determine the area of regular pentagon and hexagon from real life situations,
appreciate the application of areas of polygons in real-life situations.

content: Area of a pentagon and hexagon,
inquiry_questions: How are areas of polygons useful?
coreCompetencies:
Creativity and Imagination: the learner acquires networking skills by undertaking group activities and exchanging new ideas while discussing discuss the applications of area of polygons.
Learning to learn: the learner learns independently when measuring the sides of a tringle and works out the area using the Heron’s Formula.
values:
Unity: the learner shares available resources amicably while using selected objects with the shape of a regular pentagons and hexagon when working out the area.
Responsibility: the learner offers leadership to others while discussing with peers the applications of area of polygons
pcis: Social Awareness Skills: the learner develops effective communication skills when discussing with peers the applications of area of polygons.
